definitions.explanation: A feeling of not being satisfied or pleased with something.

examples.japanese: ⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{不満|ふまん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
{不満|ふまん}そうな⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They have a dissatisfied look on their face.

notes:
Functions as a na-adjective and noun. Formed by adding the negative prefix {不|ふ} to {満足|まんぞく}.

FORMS:
・{不満|ふまん}な + noun ({不満|ふまん}な{表情|ひょうじょう} = dissatisfied expression)
・{不満|ふまん}がある (have dissatisfaction)
・{不満|ふまん}を{言|い}う (to complain)
・〜に{不満|ふまん}だ (be dissatisfied with ~)
